newOffers.title: $25 parmi & pint — Monday and Tuesday
newOffers.description: Union Hotel's supplied weekly-special artwork offers a parmi and pint for $25 on Monday and Tuesday evenings. This is a separate venue special, not the PerkDrop 20%-off lunch booking offer.
newOffers.conditions: $25 for the advertised parmi-and-pint combination. Ask the venue which pint options are included before ordering. Not the PerkDrop 20%-off lunch offer; that discount excludes existing specials. Table availability is confirmed by the venue.

newOffers.title: $28 Friday steak night
newOffers.description: Union Hotel advertises a $28 steak night every Friday from 5–9pm in artwork supplied by its venue manager. A steak weight and cut are not specified in that artwork; ask the venue about the current plate. No drink inclusion is promised.
newOffers.conditions: Advertised Friday steak-night price is $28. Confirm the cut and accompaniments with the venue. A pictured drink is not evidence that a drink is included. Not combinable with the separate PerkDrop 20%-off lunch promotion, which excludes existing specials. Table availability is confirmed by the venue.

repairWoodville.conditions: A kids meal with each purchased main meal on Monday night. Not valid on public holidays. Confirm eligible kids-menu ages and choices with the venue. This is purchase-dependent, not a completely free meal for everyone.
repairWoodville.note: Official event page explicitly states Monday 5–9pm; homepage states a kids meal with each main purchase and excludes public holidays. Kids-menu age eligibility is not stated on the reviewed pages.
